title: One .phf website connecting the story and working applications
statement: Add an evidence-based landing-page and integration plan. Reuse current apps, unify destination configuration, preserve Observatory URLs and separate local rehearsal from a publicly usable Commons runtime. Cisco implementation is present in open PRs, not current main.
conditions: Code/configuration review only; no new runtime or visual tests claimed.
Hosting target and public demo access policy require verification during execution.
No human review or accepted-decision change is recorded.
